name: impeccable-craft-skills
description: Craft skills for AI coding agents: criterion (UI/UX), codecraft (code quality), apicraft (API design), dbcraft (database), testcraft (testing), perfcraft (performance), seccraft (security), obscraft (observability), shipcraft (DevOps/CI-CD), bugcraft (debugging) — each with commands, domain references, anti-pattern bans, and a deterministic checker.
